risks.risk: Exact machine model/spec (capacity, bottle size range, power rating) is unknown, which strongly affects price.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine nameplate/serial plate and control panel model/spec label (close-up, readable text).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for an unknown-spec automatic PET bottle machine (assume not confirmed for capacity/size range).

risks.risk: Working condition cannot be verified remotely; machine may need repairs or calibration.
risks.proof: Short video of a full start-up and a production run (showing control screen, alarms, and output bottles).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (assume may require servicing/repair).

risks.risk: Mold set and tooling completeness (critical for bottle sizes) is not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all molds/tooling included, with part numbers and a count; plus a shot showing which mold is installed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing/uncertain tooling (assume buyer may need to source molds).

risks.risk: Service history and authenticity/originality cannot be confirmed without documentation.
risks.proof: Service invoice/receipt and a clear serial number/nameplate photo matching the paperwork.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without service/verification benefits (assume no documentation).

risks.risk: Potential hidden wear/damage (heater elements, gearbox, belts, sensors) not visible in a single wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of wear-prone parts (heater bands, extruder/necking area, belts/gears, sensors) and any error logs on the HMI.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average-wear/unknown condition (no premium for 'recently serviced').

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the machine nameplate/serial plate (brand, model, year, voltage/power).
Video of the machine running: start-up, no alarms, and producing bottles (show output).
Photos and count of included molds/tooling; show installed mold and any spare sets.
Service proof: dealer service invoice/receipt and any service stickers/logs.
Close-ups of key components (heater/extruder area, gearbox/belts, sensors) and the control screen showing status.
response.reason: The photo confirms it is an industrial plastic bottle making machine, but the exact model/spec, tooling completeness, and working condition cannot be verified from the single image. Without those, a reliable worst-case price in Abuja cannot be set.
